title: In This Town MOSS Grows on You While You Wait
description:
In this town, moss grows on you while you wait for someone. The man at the bus stop is mostly hedge by now. I've never had a speck, because I've never waited for anybody.

Jory and I have kept our caravan on the headland for thirty years. This autumn he's coming up green, and it won't come off when I get back.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: How much moss would be on you right now?
